text: Prosus's majority shareholder is the South African multinational Naspers; the cross-shareholding deal completed in August 2021 reduced Naspers' stake in Prosus to 56.92% while giving Prosus an approximately 49% share in Naspers.
short: Naspers holds a 56.92% stake in Prosus after the August 2021 restructuring.

source.name: Wikipedia: Naspers
source.quote: The deal, successfully completed in August 2021, reduced Naspers' stake in Prosus to 56.92% and gave Prosus an approximately 49% share in its parent company.

additionalSources.name: Wikipedia: Prosus
additionalSources.quote: Prosus majority shareholder is South African multinational mass media company Naspers.
